claims.text_ko: 조정 EBITDA(Adjusted EBITDA) · Q3: 183.7%(변화율·증가) — 전년 같은 분기보다 늘었다
claims.quote: Our Q3 Adjusted EBITDA grew by 183.7%, nearly triple the result of last year’s third quarter, while our Adjusted EBITDA margin reached a record of 20.3%, more than double the 9.4% recorded in last year’s third quarter.
claims.subject: issuer

claims.text_ko: 잉여현금흐름(Free Cash Flow) · Q3: $109.3 million — 전년 같은 기간보다 개선되었다
claims.quote: Q3 Free Cash Flow was $109.3 million, an improvement of more than $190 million year over year, bringing year-to-date Free Cash Flow to $124.7 million.
claims.subject: issuer

claims.text_ko: 잉여현금흐름(Free Cash Flow) · full year 2026 — 연간 현금 흐름이 양수가 될 것으로 예상한다
claims.note_ko: 연간 현금 흐름이 양수가 될 것으로 예상한다
claims.quote: This gives us confidence to expect that AMC will achieve the much-welcomed milestone of positive annual Free Cash Flow for the full year 2026.
claims.subject: issuer
